title: Security Audit Prep
summary: SOC2 audit scheduled for Feb 15. Need to complete access reviews, update documentation, and prepare evidence package. Penetration testing results look good.
decisions: SOC2 Type II audit scheduled for Feb 15-19
All medium+ findings from pen test must be resolved before audit
Engineering documentation target: 80% coverage by Feb 1
Evidence collection to be automated where possible
transcription: [11:00] David Kim: SOC2 audit in three weeks. Let's review readiness. [11:02] Nina Patel: Pen test results came back. Two mediums, no highs. Both remediated. [11:05] David Kim: Excellent. Access reviews? [11:07] Sarah Chen: 85% complete. Engineering is done. Waiting on sales and marketing. [11:10] David Kim: Chase them today. Documentation status? [11:12] Nina Patel: Policies are current. Runbooks need work. Targeting 80% coverage. [11:16] David Kim: Evidence package? [11:18] Nina Patel: On track. Automating most of the log collection. [11:22] David Kim: Good. Let's reconvene next week.

risks.description: Sales team may delay access review completion
Documentation gaps may be flagged by auditors
